sloka: अथ वज्री तम् आमंत्र्य मानयित्वा च तापसम् ।रथेन हय युक्तेन ययौ दिवम् अरिन्दमः ॥३-५-२४॥
transliteration: atha vajrī tam āmaṁtrya mānayitvā ca tāpasam ।rathena haya yuktena yayau divam arindamaḥ ॥3-5-24॥

translations.english: This way honouring the sage Indra, wielder of the thunderbolt, took leave of him and went to heaven in his chariot harressed with horses.
